mood: A day of shopping that goes wrong, a night of burned fingers, and two small stars on a sunny roof.

hero.alt: On a sunny city roof a pink-haired girl in black gloves fixes a small gold star at the collar of a black-haired girl, who looks out at the viewer.

media.alt: At the green rail of a rooftop high over the city, Guinevere holds her phone up at arm's length for a selfie with Vexana, a small gold star at each collar.

inserts.caption: Two faces in the little screen.
